text:
A Group I metal (lithium or potassium) is reacted with a Group VII element (chlorine or iodine).
Which compound is formed when the Group I metal of highest density reacts with the Group VII
element of lowest density?
A
potassium chloride
B
lithium chloride
C
potassium iodide
D
lithium iodide
subject: Chemistry
